environment.note: wave-08 B11 controlled control/recovery failure windows

scope: controlled only; native control is NOT_TESTED

cases.title: a retry of the same logical command keeps one identity
detail: the same logical input keeps one command identity; a different input or epoch does not collide

cases.title: a replay reuses one command identity so the Runner can dedupe
detail: the replay reused one command id (2 deliver command(s), 1 identity), so the Runner can dedupe by key

cases.title: a start that does not supersede the durable binding is refused
detail: a start at an epoch that does not supersede the durable binding is refused as stale

cases.title: a reused attempt id is refused even across a restart
detail: a reused attempt id is refused, so an ended attempt identity cannot be recycled

cases.title: a command built for the old tuple cannot be replayed at the new epoch
detail: an old-epoch command id differs from the new-epoch one, so a stale command cannot be mistaken for current

cases.title: an unresolved resource blocks new execution
detail: partial coverage keeps the barrier closed, so new execution is blocked rather than assumed safe

reasons: the endpoint reports partial coverage, so its resource list is not exhaustive

cases.title: an active writer blocks even when everything else is clean
detail: an active writer blocks the resource barrier

cases.title: creating a new execution state does not release an old resource
detail: with no observation of the old writer the barrier stays closed; a new state asserts nothing about it

notClaimed: that an unobserved writer does not exist
that a new execution state released any old resource
that native stop or unknown-send reconciliation were exercised

cases.title: an unknown send is reconciled before any retry
detail: stop reported "confirmed" from 2 physical command(s); unknown is not reported as clean

cases.title: repeated stop calls do not fabricate a stopped writer
detail: an indeterminate writer stays indeterminate across repeated stops instead of decaying to stopped

cases.title: these windows are controlled evidence and say so
detail: real vendor stop/answer/steer and unknown-send reconciliation remain untested; this suite is controlled evidence only

evidence.classification: controlled (real AttemptSupervisor + real resource-facts reader, fake Runner)
